title: 完本感言
content_zh:
《国民法医》就此完本了。
3年多的连续更新，希望能够留给大家好的回忆。
就《国民法医》的写法而言，理论上，是可以长时间的写下去的，但对作者我来说，连载的压力已经是越来越大了，也越来越力不从心了。而且，随着主角的不断升级，案件的难度也需要相应的增加，虽然仍有空间，但空间是越来越狭窄了。
完本后，应该会休息较长一段时间。
拜谢各位读者大大，在这三年多的时间里对鸟的照拂，让我可以不为生活所困，安心创作。
祝各位读者大大身体健康，事事顺心。
等明年，待鸟休养生息，膘肥体健后，再来被逗。
content_en:
This is the end of "National Forensic Medicine".
After more than 3 years of continuous updates, I hope it can leave you with good memories.
As far as the writing method of "National Forensic Medicine" is concerned, in theory, it can be written for a long time, but for me, the author, the pressure of serialization is getting bigger and bigger, and it is becoming more and more beyond my ability. Moreover, as the protagonist continues to upgrade, the difficulty of the case also needs to increase accordingly. Although there is still room, the space is getting narrower.
After finishing this book, you should take a long break.
Thank you all readers for taking care of the birds over the past three years or so, so that I can create with peace of mind without being trapped by life.
I wish all readers good health and everything goes well.
Wait until next year, when the bird is recuperating and healthy, and then you can be teased again.
